Definition: a descendant of the fourth generation, i.e. great great grandchild
BiblicalUsage: The sense of ribbêaʻ is a descendant of the fourth generation, that is great great grandchild. It stands in Deuteronomy 5:9, "…the LORD thy God a jealous God, visiting…", and in Exodus 20:5, "…the LORD thy God a jealous God, visiting…".
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that ribbêaʻ counts, because God put it in his book.
